Carbon Fibre Wraps in Toronto

Give your vehicle a personalized touch. The Vinyl Wrap Toronto team recently wrapped this car’s hood with an elegant carbon fibre wrap.

Do you have a car or vehicle that could use a bit of personalization? We’re here to make it happen. Please speak to our team for a free quote; our designers will bring your idea to life. whether you’re looking for some fancy decals or a full coverage wrap, we do it all.

Call 416-746-1381 or you can also send us a quick message for a free estimation.
